title: Check if a Parentheses String Can Be Valid
goal: Decide whether changing unlocked parentheses can produce a valid string.
strategy: Every prefix must be able to provide enough opens, and every suffix enough closes. Treat unlocked positions as the helpful direction in each scan; even length plus both capacity checks is sufficient.
